}
need={g for v in markers.values() for g in v}
coords={}
pat=re.compile(r'gene_name \"(["'^"]+)"'"')
with gzip.open('gencode.v44.annotation.gtf.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(fields)<9 or fields[2] "'!= '"'gene': continue
        m=pat.search(fields[8])
        if not m: continue
        name=m.group(1)
        if name in need and fields[0] in ['chr'+str(i) for i in range(1,23)]+['chrX','chrY']:
            coords[name]=(fields[0], int(fields[3])-1, int(fields[4]), fields[6])
print('coord found count', len(coords))
# load matrix
df=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.atac.q2.tsv.gz', sep='\\t')
cts=list(df.columns[3:])
tot=df[cts].sum()
# CPM per bin, log not for sums
for window in [10000,50000,100000,250000]:

    scores=pd.DataFrame(0.0,index=markers.keys(),columns=cts)

import gzip,re,bisect,math
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
# Parse protein-coding/gene TSS coordinates from GENCODE
pat_name=re.compile(r'gene_name \"(["'^"]+)"'"')
pat_type=re.compile(r'gene_type \"(["'^"]+)"'"')
tss_by_chr={}
with gzip.open('gencode.v44.annotation.gtf.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('#'): continue
        fields=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(fields)<9 or fields[2] "'!= '"'gene': continue
        chrom=fields[0]
        if chrom not in ['chr'+str(i) for i in range(1,23)]+['chrX']: continue
        m=pat_name.search(fields[8]); mt=pat_type.search(fields[8])
        if not m: continue
        name=m.group(1); typ=mt.group(1) if mt else ''
        if typ not in ('protein_coding','lncRNA','miRNA'): continue
        start=int(fields[3])-1; end=int(fields[4]); strand=fields[6]
        tss=start if strand=='+' else end
        tss_by_chr.setdefault(chrom,[]).append((tss,name))
for c in tss_by_chr: tss_by_chr[c].sort()

def nearest(chrom, pos, maxdist=200000):
    arr=tss_by_chr.get(chrom,[]); xs=[x[0] for x in arr]
    i=bisect.bisect_left(xs,pos); best=None
    for j in [i-2,i-1,i,i+1,i+2]:
        if 0<=j<len(arr):
            d=abs(arr[j][0]-pos)
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,arr[j][1])
    if best and best[0]<=maxdist: return best[1],best[0]
    return '.',None

df=pd.read_csv('sample.swap.atac.q2.tsv.gz', sep='\\t')
cts=list(df.columns[3:])
X=df[cts].astype(float)
tot=X.sum(axis=0)
log=np.log2(X.div(tot,axis=1)*1e6 + 1)
# z across cell types per bin, plus margin versus second best
Z=(log.sub(log.mean(axis=1),axis=0)).div(log.std(axis=1,ddof=0).replace(0,np.nan),axis=0).fillna(0)
for ct in cts:
    z=Z[ct]
    # require enough raw signal, margin; choose bins where target highest
    others=Z[[c for c in cts if c"'!=ct]].max(axis=1)
    margin=z-others
    idx=np.where((z>2.0) & (margin>0.5) & (X[ct]>=5))[0]
    order=idx[np.argsort((-margin.iloc[idx]).values)]
    seen=set(); rows=[]
    for ii in order:
        chrom=df.at[ii,'"'chrom']; mid=(df.at[ii,'start']+df.at[ii,'end'])//2
        gene,dist=nearest(chrom,mid)
        key=gene if gene"'!='"'.' else f'{chrom}:{mid//100000}'
        if key in seen: continue
        seen.add(key)
        rows.append((gene,dist,chrom,df.at[ii,'start'],df.at[ii,'end'],z.iloc[ii],margin.iloc[ii],X.at[ii,ct]))
        if len(rows)>=25: break
    print('\\n==',ct,'==')
    for r in rows:
        print('\\t'.join(map(str,r)))
PY"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
rna=pd.read_csv('multiome.match.atac.rna.q1.rna.tsv.gz', sep='\\t')
cols=[str(i) for i in range(8)]
markers = {
'Rod':['RHO','NRL','GNAT1','PDE6A','PDE6B','SAG','CNGA1','RCVRN'],
'Cone':['OPN1LW','OPN1MW','OPN1SW','ARR3','GNAT2','PDE6C','CNGB3','GNGT2'],
'Mullerglia':['RLBP1','GLUL','SOX9','VIM','AQP4','CRYAB','CLU','SLC1A3'],
'Astrocyte':['GFAP','ALDH1L1','S100B','AQP4','SOX9','GJA1','SLC1A3'],
'Microglia':['CX3CR1','P2RY12','AIF1','TYROBP','C1QA','C1QB','CSF1R','SPI1','PTPRC'],
'Retinalganglioncell':['RBPMS','SNCG','THY1','POU4F1','POU4F2','NEFL','NEFM'],
'Horizontal':['LHX1','ONECUT1','ONECUT2','PROX1','CALB1','LIM2'],
'GABAamacrine':['GAD1','GAD2','SLC6A1','SLC32A1','DLX1','DLX2','TFAP2A','TFAP2B'],
'AIIamacrine':['GRIK1','SLC1A6','PCP2','CACNA2D3','MEIS2','TFAP2A','TFAP2B']
}
# log tpm z by gene across columns; average marker raw and z
rna_idx=rna.set_index('gene')
print('Marker raw top:')
for group,gs in markers.items():
    present=[g for g in gs if g in rna_idx.index]
    if not present: continue
    vals=rna_idx.loc[present,cols].astype(float).mean(axis=0)
    print(group, 'present', present, 'top3', ', '.join(f'{k}:{v:.2f}' for k,v in vals.sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).items()))
print('\\nPer-column top marker groups by z-sum')
scores=pd.DataFrame(index=markers.keys(), columns=cols, dtype=float)
log=np.log2(rna_idx[cols].astype(float)+1)
z=(log-log.mean(axis=1).values[:,None])/(log.std(axis=1,ddof=0).replace(0,np.nan).values[:,None])
z=z.fillna(0)
for group,gs in markers.items():
    present=[g for g in gs if g in z.index]
    scores.loc[group]=z.loc[present].mean(axis=0)
print(scores.round(2).to_string())
for c in cols:
    print(c, scores[c].sort_values(ascending=False).head(4).to_dict())
